hero.headline: Promoting Scientific Entrepreneurship & Technology Incubation at IISER Bhopal
hero.subcopy: IICE is a Technology Business Incubator supported by NSTEDB, DST, Government of India under the NIDHI-TBI scheme, fostering scientific entrepreneurship at IISER Bhopal.

pitchBand.title: Submit an Preliminary Incubation Enquiry or Technology Pitch
pitchBand.body: Researchers, faculty, students, and external entrepreneurs may submit an initial concept note below for preliminary review by the IICE Technical Cell, or proceed directly to the full application form.
